title: Adults Only Magic Show at GTS Theatre
includes: Doors Open 45 Minutes Prior to Show, Doors CLOSE 10 minutes Prior To Show - No Late Arrivals
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This adults-only magic show at GTS Theatre combines sharp comedy with mind-bending illusions for an unforgettable night. Every performance, held most Fridays at 7 PM starting June 2026, is a unique experience filled with spontaneous audience participation, ensuring that no two shows are ever the same. With quick-witted banter and astonishing tricks, laughter and amazement go hand in hand, making it the perfect outing for date nights or group gatherings. Prepare to be fully engaged and entertained at this interactive show where you become part of the magic.

This show is not dirty—it features adult humor presented in an adult setting to ensure everyone is comfortable with the material. This is a strictly 18+ event, and no one under the age of 18 will be admitted—no exceptions. We want this to be a fun, relaxed environment where adults can cut loose and have a great time.
